split_config.unit: student record; not school or time

metrics.selection_rule: Choose lowest validation MAE; within 0.02 grade points of the minimum prefer, in order: G2 persistence, training mean, two-grade ridge, expanded ridge, two-grade forest, expanded forest. Test errors and coverage never select the predictor or interval settings.
metrics.evaluation_limitations: Random record splits do not establish performance on later cohorts or other institutions. The bundled test results informed this repair and are reused for comparison, not independent confirmation. No seed search was performed; repeated use of uploaded-history results also weakens independence.
metrics.prediction_timing: After period two; recorded G2 required
metrics.bounding_policy: Raw predictions and intervals; no clipping during calibration, evaluation, inference or export.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Reject missing required inputs; no imputation
metrics.preprocessing: Fold-fitted StandardScaler and fixed yes/no one-hot categories; persistence passes through G2
metrics.subject: mat
metrics.source: Cortez (2008), UCI Student Performance, DOI 10.24432/C5TG7T, CC BY 4.0
metrics.load_notice: Verified saved predictor and evaluation bundle.

legacy.limitation: Previously inspected test records; reproduction is not independent confirmation.

kaggle.split_policy: Seed 42, 20% of identical-input groups held out; grouped stratified 5-fold CV on remaining rows.
kaggle.selection_rule: Highest mean validation macro F1; candidate order resolves exact ties. No test-based selection.
kaggle.limitations: Records lack student identifiers and measurement cutoff dates. Identical predictor groups are separated, but repeated-student overlap cannot be ruled out. Results are retrospective, not verified early-warning or local-school performance.
